## Analysis

The only durable advance is the 277-point tensor-derived incumbent; all fixed-17 local searches plateaued at 1.073430, while interval, affine-copy, symmetric-core, periodic-lift, projection, and deletion variants failed to improve 1.079441. This indicates useful gains come from controlled collisions in a high-dimensional digital construction, not ordinary coordinate tweaks. Projection sweeps refute simple linear re-embedding, but nonlinear carry patterns remain largely unexplored. Recent crashes provide no mathematical evidence.

## Next

Starting from the exact sol_0012 set, exhaustively test nonlinear digit maps \(f_{q,c}(x,y)=x+qy+cxy\) on its underlying occupied tensor cells for `q=20..80` and `c=-8..8`, deduplicate, retain `2<=n<=512`, and exactly score every image; then spend the remaining 150 seconds annealing `q`, `c`, and 1–3 cell toggles around the best image, atomically checkpointing improvements.
